t: Shopping app Wish is huge, cheap, and very, very weird
s: June 17, 2019 - While some might question whether “fun” is the right descriptor for a strange, phallic-looking object appearing in their Facebook feed, there’s no doubt that the ads — which the company runs alongside more predictable ones for products like clothing and electronics — are getting people’s attention. Once they’ve downloaded the app, Wish users scroll through the app for an average of 20 minutes per day, Lehrman says. Unlike most of its competitors, Wish is resolutely mobile-first, taking cues from Instagram’s infinite feed and popular gaming apps with elements like a daily “Blitz Buy” wheel users can spin to unlock limited-time deals and pop-ups that promise further unspecified discounts if shoppers add an item to their cart.
